title: Unauthenticated install-token registration route has no included regression coverage
reasoning: This route is a network- and auth-boundary entrypoint that issues a durable install token and server-owned identity. The feature metadata includes no linked tests, so there is no first-class evidence that the API contract is locked down for status codes, response shape, forbidden extra fields, service-unavailable behavior, or token issuance behavior.
recommendation: Add focused FastAPI route tests covering successful registration, 503 when install_auth_service is absent, extra request fields rejected by the Pydantic model, and propagation/mapping of service failures if the service has defined error modes.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The provided feature metadata lists no tests, and the only included file is the route implementation.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add tests/backend coverage for POST /api/install/register using a test FastAPI app with app.state.install_auth_service stubbed for success and absent-service cases, plus a request with an unexpected JSON field to assert validation failure.
minimumFixScope: Add route-level backend tests for backend/src/api/auth/router.py without changing the route contract unless those tests reveal a contract mismatch.
